classes.name: FilletSurf_Builder
classes.summary: API giving the following geometric information about fillets list of corresponding NUBS surfaces for each surface: the 2 support faces on each face: the 3d curve and the corresponding 2d curve the 2d curves on the fillet status of start and end section of the fillet first and last parameter on edge of the fillet.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (S: TopoDS_Shape, E: NCollection_List_TopoDS_Shape, R: number, Ta?: number, Tapp3d?: number, Tapp2d?: number)
constructors.comment:
initialize of the information necessary for the computation of the fillet on the Shape S from a list of edges E and a radius R.
Ta is the angular tolerance Tapp3d is the 3d approximation tolerance Tapp2d is the 2d approximation tolerance

instanceMethods.name: Perform
instanceMethods.comment: --Purpose computation of the fillet (list of NUBS)

instanceMethods.name: IsDone
instanceMethods.comment: gives the status about the computation of the fillet returns: IsOK :no problem during the computation IsNotOk: no result is produced IsPartial: the result is partial

instanceMethods.name: StatusError
instanceMethods.comment: gives information about error status if IsDone=IsNotOk returns EdgeNotG1: the edges are not G1 FacesNotG1 : two connected faces on a same support are not G1 EdgeNotOnShape: the edge is not on shape NotSharpEdge: the edge is not sharp PbFilletCompute: problem during the computation of the fillet

instanceMethods.name: NbSurface
instanceMethods.comment: gives the number of NUBS surfaces of the Fillet.

instanceMethods.name: Section
Section_1
Section_2
instanceMethods.signature: (IndexSurf: number, IndexSec: number): { Circ: Geom_TrimmedCurve; [Symbol.dispose](): void }

instanceMethods.name: SurfaceFillet
instanceMethods.comment: gives the NUBS surface of index Index.

instanceMethods.name: TolApp3d
instanceMethods.comment: gives the 3d tolerance reached during approximation of surface of index Index

instanceMethods.name: SupportFace1
instanceMethods.comment: gives the first support face relative to SurfaceFillet(Index);

instanceMethods.name: SupportFace2
instanceMethods.comment: gives the second support face relative to SurfaceFillet(Index);

instanceMethods.name: CurveOnFace1
instanceMethods.comment: gives the 3d curve of SurfaceFillet(Index) on SupportFace1(Index)

instanceMethods.name: CurveOnFace2
instanceMethods.comment: gives the 3d curve of SurfaceFillet(Index) on SupportFace2(Index)

instanceMethods.name: PCurveOnFace1
instanceMethods.comment: gives the PCurve associated to CurvOnSup1(Index) on the support face

instanceMethods.name: PCurve1OnFillet
instanceMethods.comment: gives the PCurve associated to CurveOnFace1(Index) on the Fillet

instanceMethods.name: PCurveOnFace2
instanceMethods.comment: gives the PCurve associated to CurveOnSup2(Index) on the support face

instanceMethods.name: PCurve2OnFillet
instanceMethods.comment: gives the PCurve associated to CurveOnSup2(Index) on the fillet

instanceMethods.name: FirstParameter
instanceMethods.comment: gives the parameter of the fillet on the first edge.

instanceMethods.name: LastParameter
instanceMethods.comment: gives the parameter of the fillet on the last edge
